voice_description: A large adult male orc warrior with a deep baritone voice, broad chest resonance, coarse gravelly timbre, firm articulation, and strong physical presence. Blunt, fearless, practical, impatient, and battle-hardened. Powerful and intimidating without needing to shout. The roughness should remain natural enough for warm, quiet, and forceful speech.
direction: The orc speaks more softly and patiently while retaining his deep coarse baritone. He sounds protective and reassuring rather than intimidating.

text: You're all right. That cut looks worse than it is. Sit here for a moment and breathe. I've seen warriors twice your size panic over less. Being frightened doesn't matter. What matters is that you got back on your feet.
